messages.text: I'm sorry to hear you're feeling that way today. It can be really heavy when things just don't feel right. Do you feel comfortable sharing what's coming up for you? I'm here to listen whenever you're ready.
everything just feels pointless rn lol

I hear how heavy that feeling of pointlessness is for you right now. Sometimes those emotions can make everything feel gray and distant. Given how hard this sounds, I need to check on your safety. Are you having any thoughts of hurting yourself?
i'm not gonna hurt myself or anything... i just wish i hadn't woken up this morning, y'know?

Thank you for being honest with me, and I appreciate you confirming you're safe right now. That feeling of wishing you hadn't woken up often signals deep exhaustion or emotional pain. It sounds like today is carrying a lot of weight for you right now. Would you like to talk about what makes this morning feel so heavy?
it's just... this constant feeling of being trapped in the wrong body. like i'll never get out from under this. been carrying it for so long, and it just *hurts*

That sounds like an incredibly painful and isolating experience to carry for so long. It makes complete sense that you would feel exhausted when your body feels like a source of distress. I want to honor how hard it is to navigate that feeling day after day. Are there any specific moments or small things that have helped you cope with this in the past?
i used to go for walks in the woods... felt some peace there, y'know? but now even that feels like too much effort. like, what's the point?

It makes sense that even things that used to bring peace feel out of reach when you're carrying this much pain. The weight of feeling trapped in your body can drain the energy needed for even simple joys. I wonder if just sitting near a window or listening to nature sounds might offer a tiny bit of that same calm without the physical effort. You don't have to find the point right now, just knowing you're here talking about this matters.
ty... it helps that you're not telling me to just go do it or whatever. just tired of being told to fix myself when i can't even get out of bed most days

I hear how exhausting it is to face constant pressure to fix yourself when you are already struggling. You deserve support without the expectation that you have to perform wellness right now. It takes real strength just to reach out even when you can't get out of bed. I am here to walk alongside you, not to push you.
idk... just talking about it like this actually feels like a tiny bit of weight off. not much, but... something

It is meaningful to hear that sharing this brought you even a small amount of relief. Those tiny moments of lightness matter so much when everything feels heavy. You don't need to fix everything today, just acknowledging that shift is important. I'm glad I could sit with you in this space.
